banner.title: flaresolverr
banner.tagline: Runs a headless browser that solves Cloudflare challenges for other apps, reachable only inside the cluster.

art.about: a headless browser clearing a challenge page and returning cookies
art.title: How FlareSolverr clears a challenge

explainer.title: A browser that hands back cookies

steps.title: Request
steps.text: A caller such as shelfmark posts a request for a protected URL to the flaresolverr Service on port 8191.
steps.scene: a paper request sliding into a door

steps.title: Solve
steps.text: FlareSolverr drives a headless Chromium session through the challenge page. No captcha solver is configured, so captcha pages fail.
steps.scene: a browser window with a shield in the corner

steps.title: Return
steps.text: It returns the final HTML and cookies, which the caller reuses for later requests.
steps.scene: a cookie handed across a counter
